summary: Plugin options are declared in the DOCUMENTATION block with fields like description, default, env, ini, vars, required, secret, type and version_added; env entries should be uppercase, collection-prefixed, and the last set one wins.
questions: How do I make a plugin option configurable via an environment variable?
Where are plugin configuration options declared?
What types can a plugin option have?
If several env vars are set for one option, which wins?

answer_card.title: Declaring plugin options
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
options:
  option_name:
    description: ...
    default: ...
    env:
      - name: MYCOLLECTION_NAME_ENV_VAR_NAME
    ini:
      - section: mycollection_section
        key: key_name
    vars:
      - name: mycollection_var
    required: false
    secret: false
    type: string
```
Types: boolean, float, integer, list, none, path, pathlist, pathspec, string, tmppath. `env` names should be uppercase and collection-prefixed; if several are set, the **last** in the list wins.
